title: VPC Peering MTU Packet Fragmentation and TCP Drops
content: When jumbo frames (MTU 9000) traverse VPC Peering connections configured with standard MTU 1500, silent TCP packet fragmentation and connection timeouts occur. The payment service checkout API fails with HTTP 504. Workaround: clamp MSS to 1460 in iptables or configure MTU 1500 across all VPC network interfaces.

title: Payment Gateway Circuit Breaker Tripping on Database Lock Escalation
content: Payment Gateway microservice relies on the Transaction DB. When high-volume batch billing runs concurrently with checkout traffic, row-level locks escalate to table locks, causing connection starvation and triggering the Resilience4j circuit breaker. Resolution: Isolate batch billing to read replicas and tune connection timeout to 10s.
